correctness.rationale: For generic conics parametrized by independent triples of binary quadratics, absence of coordinate-vertex zeros makes [Ai(s)Ti(t)] a basepoint-free (2,2) morphism. Ampleness makes it finite and intersection gives degree 8. Riemann-Hurwitz yields (4,4) ramification; the exact mod-101 coefficient witness checks all projective charts and makes smoothness a nonempty generic open, so connected smooth (4,4) gives genus 9. For each coordinate line, zeros of first/second coordinate quadratics and two critical points of the other ratio give eight smooth transverse folds; simultaneous coordinate zeros give four immersed tangencies with contact order two. The exact witness has twelve distinct branch images (verified 12 residues), forcing deg B=16 from R.(2,2)=16, birational normalization, and delta=(15*14/2)-9=96. No assertion about off-axis singularity types. Independent SymPy mod-101 Groebner/gcd and target-coordinate checks reconstruct the necessary finite certificate; finite-field witness proves only openness, not the geometric theorem by itself.
